messages.敵味方を問わず体力の低い順に当て、味方には回復・クイック・資源獲得量+1を配る、: A support-specialized E.G.O, assuming Threadspin Ⅴ, that hits targets in order of lowest HP regardless of side and hands allies healing, Haste, and +1 E.G.O Resource Amp.
messages.体力の低い順に攻撃: 現体力が最も低い対象を狙う広域(加重値7)。味方に当たると: **Attacks in order of lowest HP**: A multi-target attack (7 Attack Weight) aimed at the targets with the lowest current HP. Allies it hits take 0 damage, and their Defense skills do not trigger. It is basically a one-sided attack.
messages.味方への回復と補助: 的中した味方を、的中人数ぶん(1人5%、最大20%)だけシ: **Healing and support for allies**: Allies hit are healed based on Sinclair's max HP by an amount per number of allies hit (5% per ally, up to 20%), and receive +1 Resource Amp and 2 Haste next turn.
messages.資源の回収: 資源獲得量+1で味方が次ターンに得る資源が増え、人数と行動数しだい: **Recovering resources**: With +1 Resource Amp, allies gain more resources next turn, and depending on the number of allies and actions, it can recover the resources spent.
messages.裏面の火傷: 裏面的中時に火傷7を付与する。味方に当たると味方にも付く点に注意。: **Burn on Tails**: Inflicts 7 Burn on Tails Hit. Note that allies hit also receive it.
messages.パッシブ「シチュー噴出」: 火傷を付与する基本攻撃スキルでは、加算コインなら精神: **Passive — Stew Spewage**: For basic attack skills that inflict Burn: with Plus Coins, restores 4 SP below 40 SP, or +10% damage at 40 or more. With Minus Coins, loses 4 SP above −25, or +10% damage at −25 or below.
messages.味方を多く巻き込める場面で撃つ。低体力の敵が多いと味方に飛ばず、人数が少ないと回: Fire it when it can catch many allies. With many low-HP enemies, it does not reach allies, and with few allies hit, the healing also drops.
messages.次ターンは増えた資源でE.G.Oを撃つ流れが基本。: The basic flow is to use the increased resources next turn to fire E.G.O.
messages.必要資源は憤怒3・色欲2、精神消耗は覚醒15。侵蝕は資源を追加で消費して火力を出: It requires 3 Wrath and 2 Lust, with an Awakening Sanity cost of 15. Corrosion spends extra resources for damage but tends to catch the lowest-HP ally, so manage SP to avoid Corrosion.
messages.Ⅱ: 裏面的中時の火傷1のみ。単独では弱い。: **Ⅱ**: Only 1 Burn on Tails Hit. Weak on its own.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力と回復量が増え、資源獲得量+1が付く。: **Ⅲ**: Increases power and healing, and adds +1 Resource Amp.
messages.Ⅴ: 全的中で回復・資源獲得量+1・クイック2が確定し、自分の精神力と体力も回復: **Ⅴ**: All hits guarantee healing, +1 Resource Amp, and 2 Haste, and he also recovers his own SP and HP. The passive gains SP changes, and Corrosion is strengthened. This is where it becomes practical.
messages.夜明事務所フィクサー: S1・S3が火傷を付与し(S2は回数増加)、S3(憤怒): **[Dawn Office Fixer](persona:1009)**: S1 and S3 inflict Burn (S2 increases Count), and S3 (Wrath) and his Defense skill (Lust) supply the required affinities.
messages.東部親指ソルダートII: S1(色欲)・S3(憤怒)で必要資源を出せ、火傷も付与: **[The Thumb East Soldato II](persona:1013)**: S1 (Lust) and S3 (Wrath) supply the required affinities, and he also inflicts Burn.
